limitations: No full Connected room; D-27 owns layout, focus and visible return navigation. F-25 wider navigation remains separate.
No live hosted OAuth/enrollment/provider certification or paid model calls. Existing one-time state, PKCE and hosted enrollment nonce implementations are reused.
Google stored grant and channel adapter evidence are observations, not new remote probes. Manual credential values remain unverified.
Non-default project/owner scopes cannot launch instance-owned setup. Source failures/overflow are explicit unavailable states.
Six optional Q integration tests skipped because providers are absent from this staged base. Native Figma source unavailable.
rollback: Disable JARVIS_BRIEF_CONNECTIONS and restart. Retain canonical credentials and history. No migration to undo. Preserve main connection isolation/update safety guards. Do not replay setup or effects.
